# Wassenger for Restaurants

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — A playbook for restaurant, café, and food-business owners who want WhatsApp to handle the busywork: reservations, confirmations and reminders (no-show prevention), menus and daily specials, waiting lists, takeaway orders, and loyalty re-engagement — driven through the Wassenger platform. By @wassengerhq, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: this skill requires a paid Wassenger subscription and a WhatsApp Business API number (WhatsApp charges its own per-conversation fees); setup is technical — expect to wire a reservation system or spreadsheet, approved message templates, and the Wassenger MCP server; some examples in the skill are written in Spanish. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
